Reproduced by both differentials, for example M3TreeLayoutCacheDifferential seed 21 step 115 (stock row 9 y 151, previous row ends at 148) and M3JTreeViewportDifferential seed 104 step 129 (two-line HTML label changed to one line: stock row 1 y 40, row 0 ends at 20).
m3_behaviour: Rows keep exact y origins: the M3 cache keeps no stored y origins; y is the Fenwick prefix sum of the cached heights.
cause_stock_file_line: src/java.desktop/share/classes/javax/swing/tree/VariableHeightLayoutCache.java:436-440 (treeNodesChanged calls updateYLocationsFrom only when changedNode.getRow() != -1; the hidden root's row is -1)

stock_behaviour: No range check: the row reaches SizeSequence.setSize, whose tree walk adds the height into the sums of the left subtrees, so every row below moves by the new height (for example setRowHeight(-4, 18) on a 7-row table makes the preferred height 153 instead of 135). SizeSequence documents an out-of-range index as unspecified
m3_behaviour: M3SparseSizes ignores a negative index (the table is unchanged), as an index at or past the length already is in stock
cause_stock_file_line: src/java.desktop/share/classes/javax/swing/SizeSequence.java setSize/changeSize (no bounds check); JTable.setRowHeight(int, int) (checks rowHeight only)
